File format and grading rules

Use exactly three columns: BITS ID, Course, and Total Marks. Enter whole-number marks from 0 to 100. Store IDs as text to keep leading zeros. Exclude students who should receive NC. Only the first worksheet is read. Fractional marks are rejected; apply your institution’s rounding policy before import.
